text_block_list.text:
—One day, just before summer training camp 
was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... No, this won't do at all! At 
this rate, I won't even...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I gotta change everything, even more so—!

At first glance, Katsuragi Ace appeared to 
be training hard for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), but—

In truth, one could sense a feeling of 
frustration, as if she were running out of 
leeway...
choice_data_list: (I can't just leave things like this.)

text_block_list.text:
I want to find a way to help Katsuragi Ace 
sort through her feelings. But I still 
can't think of how to do it.

Just as impatience began creeping into my 
own heart—
—And then, that letter arrived for me.

What arrived in my work email inbox was a 
request from a group of Katsuragi Ace 
fans.

Some of them were inspired by Katsuragi 
Ace's run in the Takarazuka Kinen—

Or even earlier than that, there were all 
kinds of fans—those who supported 
Katsuragi Ace after watching her races and 
learning about her past.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"'Your run at the Takarazuka Kinen was so 
fiery, I couldn't take my eyes off you. I 
love how you're always overflowing with 
that "I'm gonna win!" energy.'"

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you engage in those heated battles 
with Mr. C.B. during your Classic year 
made me cheer you on with excitement every 
time."

In all the cheers of support attached to 
the request for Katsuragi Ace, one could 
feel a shared sentiment—

The request that was sent asked for advice 
on giving shape to those "feelings" and 
delivering them directly to Katsuragi Ace.

Reading through all the "feelings" sent in 
by fans for Katsuragi Ace—

—One thing came to mind that I, together 
with the fans, could do for Katsuragi Ace.

—And the summer training camp was about to 
begin.
